title: Head injury: concussion (Earth reference, no space data)

steps.text: Suspect concussion if the crewmember has trouble thinking or remembering, physical symptoms (headache, change in vision, dizziness, nausea or vomiting, seizures, sensitivity to light or noise), emotional changes, or changes in behaviour (more sleepy, less active, less responsive, confused).

source.guideline: Djärv T, Rogers J, Semeraro F, et al. European Resuscitation Council Guidelines 2025 First Aid. Resuscitation. 2025;215:110752. doi:10.1016/j.resuscitation.2025.110752 (Earth reference, no space data)
